72:1.text: , "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān

72:2.text: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

72:3.text: that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

72:4.text: has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.

72:5.text: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.

72:7.text: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone

72:8.text: the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

72:9.text: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing,
but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

72:12.text: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

72:13.text: And when we heard the guidance
